_comment: Schema template. Final artifact: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/dependencies/<KEY>-ref.json. EPIC-PREP v4: obligations_proposed[], obligations_reconcile, downstream_hints, verification_focus_proposed, principal_coverage_threads, verification_topology. COVERAGE consumes obligations + topology + principal hints. schema_version 4. Human paste: epics/<KEY>/<KEY>-coverage.md at epic root only. See docs/epic-artifact-layout.json.

_epic_archetype.source: jira_summary | jira_description | jira_scenarios | obligation_kinds | user_trigger_focus | inferred_from_jira
_epic_archetype.evidence: Short citation; verbatim Jira quotes in verification_topology or client_shell_impact evidence only

_verification_focus_proposed.statement: 1–3 sentences; Jira-derived primary focus for COVERAGE to copy without paraphrase

_pricing_oracle_rule_item.oracle_rule: first_tier_quote | text_configuration_closest_gte_qty | midpoint_invariant | mark_from_midpoint | console_show_prices_first_tier | console_agent_event_quote | console_agent_event_text_configuration | backup_midpoint_at_eod | unresolved

_principal_coverage_thread_item.title: Data setup — account groups and quote publication
_principal_coverage_thread_item.coverage_thread: environment_setup | functional_config | mapping_routing | surface_quotes | invariants | backup_eod | dimensions | deferral_only

_platform_reuse_candidate_item.suggested_crtqa_pattern: Platform regression TC family for daily_data_recorder

corner_trader.note: Short stable summary: status + source pattern; verbatim quotes go in evidence only (see epic-prep step 2b)
corner_trader.evidence: quote or field from Jira (components, labels, description)

adaptive.note: Short stable summary: status + source pattern; verbatim quotes go in evidence only (see epic-prep step 2b)

_requirements_item.snippet_failure_reason: yogi_extract_empty | no_cookie | macro_shape_unsupported | page_id_unresolved | mcp_export_failed | other
_requirements_item.observable_yield: integer >= 0; count of distinct UI parameters / table rows recognized in snippet_text (EPIC-PREP 3c). When snippet_status=ok and observable_yield>=2, require >= that many primary_candidate field obligations (availability / environment_setup do not count).

_obligations_proposed_item.kind: invariant | ladder | formula | config_posture | environment_setup | settlement | rounding | parity | explicit_deferral
_obligations_proposed_item.assertion_fragment: Short observable for checklist bullet (no repeated subsection context)
_obligations_proposed_item.evidence_anchor: snippet excerpt or jira field reference

_evidence_anchor_object.field: optional parameter name from requirement table

downstream_hints.coverage_thread: environment_setup | functional_config | mapping_routing | surface_quotes | invariants | backup_eod | dimensions | deferral_only

_obligations_reconcile_conflict_item.reason: Epic summary silent but snippet requires primary check
